title: Clearer conversations and easier fishing
text: When you talk to someone, their face is now framed clearly above the words.
The fishing bobber is larger, with a pale top, and a bite is easier to see on a phone.

CAST, HOOK and REEL now work from the big button in the middle of the screen and from the corner button. The on-screen instructions tell you when to hold and when to release, and you can watch the progress as the fish comes in.
